tagline: Bridge your Discord community and Slack work channels automatically
metaTitle: Slack Discord Integration: Connect Community and Team
metaDescription: Mirror Discord announcements to Slack and escalate community bug reports to engineering. GAIA filters what crosses over. See the setup steps.
intro:
Many teams run their public community on Discord while internal collaboration happens in Slack. Without a bridge, community managers must manually relay feedback, bug reports, and feature requests to engineering and product teams, adding delay and losing context.

GAIA connects the two so important community signals reach the right work channels automatically. Announcements posted internally can be mirrored to the community in seconds, and flagged community messages can surface directly in Slack threads, keeping both audiences informed without duplicate effort.

useCases.title: Mirror Discord announcements to Slack
useCases.description: When a message is posted in a Discord announcement channel, GAIA forwards it to the designated internal channel. Internal teams stay informed of community news without monitoring the community server directly.

useCases.title: Escalate community bug reports to engineering
useCases.description: GAIA watches support channels for messages tagged with bug keywords and routes them, with context, to your engineering channel. Engineers see real user issues without leaving Slack.

useCases.title: Post release notes from Slack to Discord
useCases.description: When your team posts a release update internally, GAIA formats and publishes it to the appropriate community channel so your community is always first to hear about new features.

useCases.title: Sync community feedback to the product channel
useCases.description: GAIA collects reactions and feedback threads above a threshold and posts a daily digest to your product channel. Product managers get a clear picture of community sentiment without context switching.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and Slack workspace. Select which channels on each side should be linked.
Define which events (announcements, flagged messages, keywords) should post to which destination channels. Set formatting preferences so messages read naturally on both sides.
Once configured, GAIA monitors both sides and routes messages according to your rules. Your community and internal teams stay synchronized without any manual forwarding.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync messages in both directions between Discord and Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. Routing works from the community to the workspace and from the workspace back to the community. You configure which channels and event types trigger each direction independently.

faqs.question: Will internal messages be exposed to the community?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA only posts to the community when you explicitly configure a rule for that direction. Internal-only channels are never exposed unless you set up a rule to share them.

faqs.question: Can I filter which messages get forwarded?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can filter by keyword, channel, role, reaction count, or message type so only relevant signals reach your team. Noise from casual community chat is excluded by default.
